pages.text: A dispenser that launches creatures instead of items. Whatever it fires leaves the barrel as a ragdoll.
Look at the cannon and hold $(k:key.sablemaidragdoll.aim_cannon) to adjust its direction, then drag the mouse. Hold shift to snap the angles to whole degrees and release the key when you are done.

The middle slot is the ammo slot:$(li)a $(l:touhou_little_maid:other/camera_and_photo)Maid Photo$(/l) fires its maid and is consumed;$(li)a Soul Spell holding a maid fires her and is left empty and reusable;$(li)any spawn egg spawns its creature and fires it, without being used up.

The lower right slot is the upgrade slot:$(li)Bow - adds spread;$(li)TNT - triples launch speed;$(li)Redstone Dust - cooldown down to 0.5 s;$(li)Ultrasonic Wave Generator - cooldown down to 0.25 s;$(li)Maid Mace - the ragdoll explodes where it lands.

A redstone signal makes the cannon fire once per second, or faster with a cooldown upgrade. Maids become ragdolls as they are launched, and anything that cannot be ragdolled is simply thrown.$(br2)In a pinch you can put a Mob Cannon into another cannon's upgrade slot and leave the ammo empty: it will then load the nearest player, firing on every redstone pulse instead of continuously. Anyone fired that way has a hidden advancement to find.
